scan_metadata.paper: Diffusion differentiable resampling (Andersson & Zhao, ICML 2026; arXiv:2512.10401)
scan_metadata.explanation: Static scan of README, diffres/*.py, demos (4 scripts + notebook), tests (3), experiments (scripts, run_*.sh, summary). No code was executed. Five tools selected over three modules; six execution assignments proposed (two marked optional). Experiments other than one smallest-setting LGSSM and one GMS run are verification references only; CIFAR-10, Lotka-Volterra training, profiling, sweeps and summaries are omitted with reasons.

tutorials.title: Diffusion resampling example (Gaussian mixture)
tutorials.description: Official tutorial: builds a 5-component GM prior in d=10 with linear Gaussian likelihood (dy=2), importance-weights 1024 prior samples, resamples with diffusion_resampling(a=-2, ts=linspace(0,1,33), integrator=jentzen_and_kloeden, ode=True), ensemble_ot(eps=0.3) and multinomial, and plots against exact posterior samples (gm_lin_posterior + sampling_gm). Outputs: one saved figure (image/png); no printed numbers.

suggested_tools.source_section: cell 6 "Resampling starts" (diffusion_resampling call), inputs from cell 4
suggested_tools.description: Resample a user-supplied weighted particle set with diffusion resampling (empirical diagonal Gaussian reference), returning equally weighted, differentiable-by-construction resamples.
suggested_tools.primary_input: samples (n, d) [or (n, ...)] as inline JSON list or path to .npy/.csv; log_weights (n,) or weights (n,); a < 0 (docstring: must be negative); T and nsteps -> ts=linspace(0,T,nsteps+1) as in every upstream caller (optionally explicit ts); integrator in {euler, lord_and_rougemont, jentzen_and_kloeden, diffrax (ode only), tweedie (sde only)}; ode bool; jitter >= 0; seed int -> jax.random.PRNGKey(seed). Enable jax_enable_x64 as all upstream callers do. Keep einsum internal (GPU-utilisation switch only).
suggested_tools.outputs: resampled particles (n, d) saved to file plus inline when small; output log weights (uniform -log n); brief summary (input ESS, weighted mean of input vs mean of output).
suggested_tools.upstream_callable: diffres/resampling.py::diffusion_resampling(key, log_ws, samples, a, ts, integrator="euler", ode=True, jitter=0., einsum=False)

tutorials.title: Resampling unit tests
tutorials.description: Weighted 1-D sample (n=10000, uniform on [-2,2], log weights = N(0; x, 1)); checks sliced-Wasserstein distance between resampled and weighted original for soft_resampling(alpha=1-1e-3), gumbel_softmax(tau=1e-3) [atol 1e-4], diffusion_resampling(a=-0.5, ts=linspace(0,1,16)) for integrators euler/lord_and_rougemont/jentzen_and_kloeden x ode/sde, diffrax (ode only), tweedie (sde only) [atol 1e-3], ensemble_ot(eps=0.1) [atol 3e-3]; test_diffres_versions checks diffusion_resampling == diffusion_resampling_generic with the empirical Gaussian reference (exact allclose).

suggested_tools.source_section: test_misc_resamplings, test_ensemble_ot (soft_resampling, gumbel_softmax, ensemble_ot); multinomial/stratified/systematic/multinomial_stopped via tests/test_filters.py::test_smc
suggested_tools.description: Resample the same kind of weighted particle set with one of the baseline resamplers implemented in the repository, for comparison with diffusion resampling.
suggested_tools.primary_input: samples, log_weights/weights, seed as above; method in {multinomial, stratified, systematic, multinomial_stopped, ensemble_ot, soft, gumbel_softmax}; method parameters eps (+implicit_diff) for ensemble_ot, alpha in [0,1] for soft, tau > 0 for gumbel_softmax.
suggested_tools.outputs: resampled particles (n, d) and output log weights (soft_resampling returns non-uniform normalised log weights; others uniform), same summary as the diffusion tool.
suggested_tools.upstream_callable: diffres/resampling.py::multinomial, stratified, systematic, multinomial_stopped, ensemble_ot(eps=None->1/log n, implicit_diff=True), soft_resampling(alpha), gumbel_softmax(tau)

tutorials.title: Filter and SMC unit tests
tutorials.description: 1-D OU-type LGSSM (semigroup exp(-dt), trans_cov 1-exp(-2dt), H=1, R=1, m0=0, P0=1, 101 observations ys=N(0,1) draws). test_kf: kf+rts match closed-form GP regression mean/variance/nll. test_smc: smc_feynman_kac with multinomial, multinomial_stopped, stratified, systematic (1000 particles) nll vs KF nll rtol 6e-2. test_diffres: diffusion_resampling inside SMC (a=-0.5, ts=linspace(0,2,8), sde, 4 integrators) rtol 5e-2. test_ensemble_ot: eps=0.1, rtol 7e-2.

suggested_tools.source_section: m0_sampler, log_g0, m_log_g, test_smc, test_diffres, test_ensemble_ot (smc_feynman_kac)
suggested_tools.description: Run a bootstrap particle filter (SMC) on a linear Gaussian state-space model given as JSON matrices with a chosen resampler (diffusion or any baseline), returning filtering particles/weights, ESS and the log-likelihood estimate; optionally its gradient w.r.t. model matrices and a comparison with the exact Kalman filter.
suggested_tools.primary_input: F (dx,dx), Q (dx,dx), H (dy,dx), R (dy,dy), m0 (dx,), P0 (dx,dx), ys (N+1, dy) with ys[0] the time-0 observation (used by log_g0, matching kf); nparticles; resampler name + its parameters (same set as the two resampling tools); resampling_threshold in (0,1]; seed; return_gradient bool; compare_to_kalman bool.
suggested_tools.outputs: filtering particles (N+1, s, dx) and log weights (N+1, s) saved to .npz; weighted filtering means/covariances; ESS (N+1,); negative log-likelihood (upstream returns nll; also report log-likelihood = -nll); optional jax.value_and_grad gradient of nll w.r.t. F and H (as in demos/gradient_variance2.py and the L-BFGS objective in experiments/lgssm); optional KF nll and mean KL / Bures filtering errors.
suggested_tools.upstream_callable: diffres/feynman_kac.py::smc_feynman_kac(key, m0, log_g0, m_log_g, pytree=ys, nparticles, nsteps=N, resampling, resampling_threshold=1., return_path=True)

tutorials.title: Gradient of PF log-likelihood: diffusion vs stopped-gradient multinomial
tutorials.description: Simulates a 1-D LGSSM with simulate_lgssm (F=0.5, Q=1, H=1, R=1, P0=1, PRNGKey(666), default 128 steps); computes the exact KF negative log-likelihood and its gradient w.r.t. theta=(scale of F, scale of H) at theta=(0.2,0.2), then 1000 Monte Carlo jax.value_and_grad evaluations of the PF nll with diffusion_resampling (a=-1, T=2, 128 steps, euler, ode, jitter=1e-5) and multinomial_stopped (8 particles); prints KF loss/grad, MC means and gradient RMSEs.

suggested_tools.source_section: kf / loss_kf + jax.value_and_grad (lines 40-43, 92-101); kf+rts also in tests/test_filters.py::test_kf
suggested_tools.description: Exact Kalman filter (and optional RTS smoother) for the same LGSSM JSON specification: filtering/smoothing means and covariances, exact negative log-likelihood, optional gradient of the nll w.r.t. F and H; the reference against which particle filters are judged.
suggested_tools.primary_input: F, Q, H, R, m0, P0, ys as in the particle-filter tool; smooth bool; return_gradient bool.
suggested_tools.outputs: filtering means (N+1,dx) and covariances (N+1,dx,dx); nll and log-likelihood; optional RTS smoothing means/covariances; optional gradient of nll w.r.t. F and H.
suggested_tools.upstream_callable: diffres/gaussian_filters.py::kf(ys, m0, v0, semigroup, trans_cov, obs_op, obs_cov) -> (mfs, vfs, nll, mps, vps); rts(mfs, vfs, mps, vps, semigroup) -> (mss, vss)

suggested_tools.description: Simulate a latent trajectory and observations from an LGSSM JSON specification, so users can generate inputs for the two filter tools.
suggested_tools.primary_input: F, Q, H, R, m0, P0 (Q, R, P0 positive definite), nsteps N, seed.
suggested_tools.outputs: xs (N+1, dx), ys (N+1, dy) saved to .npz/.json for reuse by the filter tools.
suggested_tools.upstream_callable: diffres/tools.py::simulate_lgssm(key, semigroup, trans_cov, obs_op, obs_cov, m0, v0, nsteps) -> (xs (N+1,dx), ys (N+1,dy))

tutorials.title: LGSSM experiment, diffusion resampling
tutorials.description: Per MC seed: simulate LGSSM (F=0.5, Q=1, H=1, R=0.5), PF-vs-KF loss over a hard-coded 128x128 parameter grid, filtering KL and Bures errors between PF weighted moments and KF moments at the true parameters (lines 115-122), and L-BFGS-B (jaxopt) parameter estimation. Saves ./lgssm/results/*.npz relative to cwd.
tutorials.supporting_role: Execution reference for diffres_run_lgssm_particle_filter compare_to_kalman (KL/Bures) at smallest settings; owns no tool.

tutorials.title: Gaussian-mixture experiment, diffusion resampling
tutorials.description: Same model as the notebook but with a quantitative metric: sliced Wasserstein (p=1) between exact posterior samples and diffusion-resampled samples, plus the posterior-mean residual. Defaults dx=8, dy=1, c=5, nsamples=10000. Saves ./gms/results/*.npz relative to cwd.
tutorials.supporting_role: Quantitative execution reference (SWD vs exact posterior) for diffres_resample_particles_diffusion; owns no tool.
